assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production low-resolution pixel sprite sheet, 28 frames, for the existing 1998 Legend of Cao Cao tactical RPG engine. Image1 is the USER'S EXACT approved visual style: study its soldiers' small heads, upright adult proportions about 3 to 3.5 heads tall, narrow shoulders and compact silhouettes. Image2 original native sprite strip is supporting reference for pixel density, minimal palette and thin dark outline. MATCH these original game sprites, NOT modern cute chibi, NOT big heads, NOT muscular cartoon heroes, NOT smooth illustrations.
Character: Song Wan, an adult broad-shouldered Chinese mountain fighter, muted brown tunic, dark headwrap, modest stubble, dark boots, single steel dao. Restraint: about 16-24 colors, 2 shades per fabric, muted colors, tiny 1-pixel facial marks, hard angular pixel clusters, thin dark outlines, no gradients, no highlights in big eyes. Natural small head matching reference soldiers. Body approximately 36 logical pixels tall, head 9-10 logical pixels tall. All frames same character, identical head size/costume/weapon proportions.
Output transparent RGBA sprite sheet on EXACT equal 4 columns x7 rows; 1024x1792 preferred. Each256 square cell contains 64x64 logical pixel artwork enlarged4x nearest-neighbor. Body foot anchor at cell x128 y200, same body scale across ALL28 poses. Native body height144px before packaging, head36px. Leave at least24px transparent gutters on every side, whole dao inside cell; no shadows, no ground, no text/grid/borders. Evenly spaced rows. No painting texture.
Row1 four FRONT/down-facing dao attack frames: ready, draw dao back, slash diagonally forward/down, recover toward upright. Motion small and readable; no huge crouch or body resize.
Row2 four BACK/up-facing equivalents: ready, pull back, slash forward/up, recover. All face away.
Row3 four LEFT-facing equivalents: ready, pull back, horizontal slash left, recover. Nose and dao strike point LEFT.
Row4 front walkA, front walkB, back walkA, back walkB. A/B opposite feet, small stable motion.
Row5 left walkA, left walkB, front idle upright, back idle upright.
Row6 left idle upright, kneeling wounded, fallen horizontal, front guard.
Row7 back guard, left guard, wounded recoil, victory dao raised.
Only28 character instances. Do not change identity or head size from pose to pose. No slash arcs or effects. IMPORTANT reference1 is target art style; remove all modern cartoon roundness.

Image3 is approved pilot sheet for exact consistent art style and 4x7 layout. Match its adult small heads and original pixel technique; change only character identity and weapon logically. All side views MUST face LEFT. Keep all pixels at least24px inside each cell.
